sentences.text: No, clause 9.3 of the copy is not compliant with the applicable RBI pre-payment rule for this case.
The copy says that, in the event of foreclosure or pre-payment of the loan, in full or in part, the Borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding.
For a UCB, where the borrower is an individual, the purpose is non_business, the rate type is floating, and the loan was sanctioned on 2026-02-10, pre-payment charge is not permitted.
The documents therefore show a conflict between the copy’s 3% charge and the applicable RBI direction that no pre-payment charge is permitted.
